list: The official 55 trophies, as listed before this guide was written
note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list as published on Exophase and PSNProfiles. Every guide below is written in our own words from the official description. Where the official description names no place, step or trigger, the guide says so plainly: it is a plan drawn from the description, not a route checked in the game.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list (official names, descriptions and grades): https://www.exophase.com/game/grand-theft-auto-vi-psn/trophies/
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list (official names, descriptions, grades and PSN progress targets): https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi
Guide text: our own advice, written from the official description for this guide; not yet checked in the game.

trophies.guide: The capstone: it unlocks the moment the other 54 trophies are earned, so there is no separate task for it. Work the roadmap in order — story first, then side strands, then activities, collectibles and the money goals — and this one takes care of itself. If it has not popped, the checklist above shows exactly which trophies are still missing.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles. Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, through to its end screen. It is the first story mission, so it unlocks naturally and cannot be missed — just follow the on-screen objectives until the mission completes.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles. Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. Story progress is shown in the pause menu, so check there if you are unsure what is left. Nothing in a chapter can be missed by exploring first — the missions wait for you.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles. Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2, in the same way as Chapter 1: play the story missions in order and the trophy pops at the chapter's end. Side activities can wait — chapters only need their missions done.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles. Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. By now the pattern is set: story missions in order, and the chapter trophy follows. Use the pause menu's story progress to confirm no mission is left undone.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles. Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4. This is the last full chapter before the finale, so clear any side strands you care about here too — the story will not wait, but the side content is easier while the map is fully open.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles. Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. Keep a manual save before starting the finale: the description names one final mission, and a save lets you replay it if anything goes wrong. The exact mission name is not stated in the official description, so treat the finale as the last story mission the game offers.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles. Guide: our own advice from the official description; the finale's exact mission name is not in the official description and is not yet checked in the game.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It is a named story mission, so it arrives in the story order — play the missions as they come and it will unlock. Flagged missable only as a precaution: a single named mission is best done the moment it appears, with a save kept beforehand, until mission replay is confirmed.
trophies.name: Trust
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles. Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions tend to have a setup phase and a payoff — do the setups as they appear so the heist itself is ready when the story calls for it. Flagged missable as a precaution, like the other named story missions: do it when it appears and keep a save.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles. Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Named story missions unlock in order, so keep playing the story and it will come up; when it does, finish it in the same session if you can. Flagged missable as a precaution: keep a save before starting it.
trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles. Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. As with the other named missions, it appears in story order and unlocks on completion — no extra objective is needed beyond finishing the mission. Flagged missable as a precaution: do it when it appears, with a save kept beforehand.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles. Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown at the airport (VCIA). The name points at an airport job, so expect a takedown in or around the airfield. Flagged missable as a precaution: a single named mission is best done when it appears, with a save kept beforehand.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles. Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. The operation name suggests a larger set-piece mission — follow its objectives stage by stage rather than rushing. Flagged missable as a precaution, like the other named story missions: do it when it appears and keep a save.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles. Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. This is the long grind behind the platinum: story, side strands, activities, collectibles and exploration all feed the percentage, and the in-game stats screen shows what is still missing. Save it for last — every other trophy in this guide moves the number, so chase this one only when the checklist is nearly empty.
trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles. Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts — jumps, near-misses, drifts and air time all count toward the total. Stunts build up across free roam, so weave them into everyday travel rather than grinding them in one sitting, and check the in-game stats page for your running total. Which moves count as a stunt is not spelled out in the official description, so treat the count as the guide and check your stats after a session.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; progress target of 250 from PSNProfiles. Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. The activities are the game's side pastimes — racing, fishing, the shooting range, arcade games and the rest — so sample one of each rather than mastering any. The official description does not list the 9 types by name, so work from the activities the map and menus offer and tick them off as you try them.
trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles. Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Practise one range at a time and learn its target pattern before chasing gold; bronze and silver first is fine, the medal upgrades. The ranges' locations are not named in the official description, so find them through the in-game map and activities list — the 42-challenge total is PSN's tracked target.
trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; progress target of 42 from PSNProfiles. Guide: our own advice from the official description; range locations are not in the official description and are not yet checked in the game.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at each of the 14 locations. Learn each course's racing line before pushing for the win, and expect the later locations to be tighter. Locations are not named in the official description; the 14-location total is PSN's tracked target.
trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; progress target of 14 from PSNProfiles. Guide: our own advice from the official description; race locations are not in the official description and are not yet checked in the game.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Variety matters — the same race twice does not add a second win — so work through the race list across the map instead of repeating your favourite. Race types and locations are not named in the official description.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; progress target of 20 from PSNProfiles. Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are head-to-head, so focus on the timing of the catch rather than speed. Where Cal's challenge is offered is not named in the official description — look for the fishing activity and its challenge marker.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles. Guide: our own advice from the official description; the challenge location is not in the official description and is not yet checked in the game.

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. Pick the shortest game in the arcade and play it through to its end screen; no score target is needed, just a completion. Which arcade and which game are not named in the official description.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles. Guide: our own advice from the official description; the arcade's location is not in the official description and is not yet checked in the game.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete Andy's final mission. Stranger strands unlock through the story and build mission by mission — follow Andy's strand to its end and the trophy pops on the last one. Flagged missable as a precaution: a strand's final mission is a single event, so keep a save before starting it.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles. Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's final mission. Work through Kenton's strand as its missions appear and finish the last one. Flagged missable as a precaution: a strand's final mission is a single event, so keep a save before starting it.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles. Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's final mission. Follow Billy's strand to its end, mission by mission, and the trophy pops on the last one. Flagged missable as a precaution: keep a save before the final mission of the strand.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles. Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Strands are the game's side-mission chains for strangers — start each one you meet and follow it through. With more than 8 strangers in the world, pick the strands whose missions suit you; the 8-strand total is PSN's tracked target.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; progress target of 8 from PSNProfiles. Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's final mission. Work through Randy's strand as its missions appear and finish the last one. Flagged missable as a precaution: a strand's final mission is a single event, so keep a save before starting it.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles. Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's final mission. Follow Tyrone's strand to its end, mission by mission, and the trophy pops on the last one. Flagged missable as a precaution: keep a save before the final mission of the strand.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles. Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. Meditation spots are quiet scenic points; visit them as you explore each region rather than hunting them all at once. The spots are not named in the official description; the 18-spot total is PSN's tracked target.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; progress target of 18 from PSNProfiles. Guide: our own advice from the official description; spot locations are not in the official description and are not yet checked in the game.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Unique animals are one-of-a-kind hunts, so take the shot carefully and save first — a failed hunt may not offer a second chance. Which animal it is and where it roams are not named in the official description.
trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles. Guide: our own advice from the official description; the animal and its location are not in the official description and are not yet checked in the game.

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida; collect full sets rather than random singles, and use the in-game collection screen to see which cards each set still needs. Card locations are not named in the official description.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; progress target of 3 from PSNProfiles. Guide: our own advice from the official description; card locations are not in the official description and are not yet checked in the game.

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK feature at 100 locations. This is a long grind — use it whenever you pass a new spot instead of saving it for the end, and let the counter build up across normal play. What counts as a location is not spelled out in the official description; the 100-location total is PSN's tracked target.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; progress target of 100 from PSNProfiles. Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges cover the game's side goals, so they accumulate as you play activities and explore; check the challenges menu to find the easiest ones still open. The challenge list itself is not named in the official description.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; progress target of 50 from PSNProfiles. Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while playing with your partner, then escape. Build the wanted level up with your partner beside you, then break line of sight and lay low until it clears. Flagged missable: the description needs your partner present, so do it during a stretch where your partner is with you, and keep a save.
trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles. Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Plan a route past three shops, keep the heat on, and do not let the wanted level drop between robberies. Flagged missable: it needs your partner and an unbroken wanted level, so save first and pick shops close together.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles. Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Simply drive or approach new vehicle models — the counter fills as you find types you have not seen before, so try every car, bike, boat and aircraft you pass. The 100-vehicle total is PSN's tracked target.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; progress target of 100 from PSNProfiles. Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during a single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a group of enemies, trigger Combat Focus, and chain the five takedowns before it ends — a crowded firefight is a better stage than a lone guard. The exact Combat Focus controls are not named in the official description.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles. Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA, the airport. The description hints at leaving the airport by an unofficial route — on foot, by vehicle or otherwise — rather than through the terminal. Flagged missable: it reads as a one-off moment, so save before trying. The exact departure is not named in the official description.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles. Guide: our own advice from the official description; the exact departure is not in the official description and is not yet checked in the game.

trophies.guide: Deal with Rhinos — tanks — while it is, as the description puts it, kinda hot in them. Expect tanks to appear at high wanted levels; use cover and heavy weapons, and do not fight them in the open. The exact trigger is not spelled out in the official description, so treat any tank encounter as the chance.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles. Guide: our own advice from the official description; the exact trigger is not in the official description and is not yet checked in the game.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet, avoid cameras and guards, and leave before any alarm sounds. Flagged missable: a failed silent run may turn loud, so save first. Which store it is is not named in the official description.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles. Guide: our own advice from the official description; the store is not named in the official description and is not yet checked in the game.

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. Plan the getaway before the robbery, not after — a fast car parked nearby matters more than the vault itself. Vault locations are not named in the official description; the 5-vault total is PSN's tracked target.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; progress target of 5 from PSNProfiles. Guide: our own advice from the official description; vault locations are not in the official description and are not yet checked in the game.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Ambush a truck on a quiet road, take it, and break away before backup arrives. Truck routes are not named in the official description.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles. Guide: our own advice from the official description; truck routes are not in the official description and are not yet checked in the game.

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Drive through every region and watch the area name appear; the map shows what is still unvisited. The 52-area total is PSN's tracked target.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; progress target of 52 from PSNProfiles. Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Hit one operation per gang across the map — the gangs' territories are marked in the world. Which operations count is not spelled out in the official description; the 9-gang total is PSN's tracked target.
trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; progress target of 9 from PSNProfiles. Guide: our own advice from the official description; operation locations are not in the official description and are not yet checked in the game.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a beachfront bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and take in the view. Flagged missable: it reads as a single quiet moment, so do it when you first reach the beach. The exact bar is not named in the official description.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles. Guide: our own advice from the official description; the exact bar is not in the official description and is not yet checked in the game.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive through the showroom's frontage and out the other side — a fast, heavy car helps. Flagged missable: a one-off stunt, so save first. Which showroom it is is not named in the official description.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles. Guide: our own advice from the official description; the showroom is not named in the official description and is not yet checked in the game.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Play a frame at that alley and complete the follow-through. Flagged missable: a named place and a single action, so save first. The alley's exact spot is not named in the official description beyond its name.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles. Guide: our own advice from the official description; the alley's exact spot is not in the official description and is not yet checked in the game.

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. This reads as a co-op moment with your partner that draws a crowd — do partner activities and watch for the prompt. Flagged missable: the description gives no concrete trigger, so keep saves around partner moments. The exact trigger is not named in the official description.
trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles. Guide: our own advice from the official description; the exact trigger is not in the official description and is not yet checked in the game.

trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse. Make story choices — the description suggests the game tracks them, with PSN counting up to 500. Flagged missable: choices may lock once made, so keep saves at decision points. Which choices count is not named in the official description.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; progress target of 500 from PSNProfiles. Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Fail something, then succeed on the retry — the trophy's name says the second attempt is the one that counts. Flagged missable: it may hinge on a specific event, so keep saves. The exact event is not named in the official description.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles. Guide: our own advice from the official description; the exact event is not in the official description and is not yet checked in the game.

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Witness something strange — the game's odd, unexplained events are the trigger. These are rare by nature, so explore the odd corners of the map and pay attention to strange sights. Flagged missable: a one-off sighting may not repeat, so save often. The exact event is not named in the official description.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles. Guide: our own advice from the official description; the exact event is not in the official description and is not yet checked in the game.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl them over with a melee drive-by. Strike someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. Flagged missable: a precise stunt, so save first and pick a quiet road. The exact method is not spelled out in the official description.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles. Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Launder marked bills steadily through the contacts the game offers; the total accumulates across many jobs, so treat it as a background goal while you play. Which contacts offer laundering, and how it unlocks, are not named in the official description.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; progress target of $250,000 from PSNProfiles. Guide: our own advice from the official description; the contacts are not named in the official description and are not yet checked in the game.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Big purchases count fastest — vehicles and property eat the total quickly — but everyday shopping adds up too. Shop spending is tracked across all shops, so just keep buying what you need.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; progress target of $100,000 from PSNProfiles. Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Buy garages as they appear on the market; they double as storage, so buy them as you can afford them. Which garages they are is not named beyond the count; the 8-property total is PSN's tracked target.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; progress target of 8 from PSNProfiles. Guide: our own advice from the official description; garage locations are not in the official description and are not yet checked in the game.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles, then register them in the app — ten different ones. The 10-vehicle total is PSN's tracked target.
trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; progress target of 10 from PSNProfiles. Guide: our own advice from the official description.
